selection.carrier_rule: canonical Markdown Atom: metadata atom-id letter agrees with nearest 0N role directory, filename begins with that atom-id, and metadata Role is coherent. Draft remains Draft; every other non-Archived status is grouped as Current.
selection.included: native control-root 0N role carriers, including top-level sources and Engine consumers

excluded.actual_operations_workflow_external_owne: 09_operations metadata Form Workflow, Step, or Action

occurrence_ledger.scope: CFEL fences plus subjects only; quoted literals and version/interval syntax remain source text
occurrence_ledger.deterministic_enumeration: sorted path, then fence/Subject position, then match position
occurrence_ledger.full_records_encoding: xz+base64 canonical JSON; decode before review/migration

deterministic_actions.action: replace legacy narrowing / with // only at the pinned CFEL/Subject occurrence
replace Kind//Name with $name[<Kind>, (.Name = Name)] only after the local binder is confirmed unique
replace legacy HAV :: with := only at positively classified HAV occurrences
replace <+ CONTAINS with / only when parsed as one containment expression
replace {n}/{:n} with {::n} only within a CFEL count annotation
replace old :literal with :=literal after expression-context review
remove @ reference prefix; preserve @N version tags

preserve_actions.action: retain Relation//NAME fixed model address; it is not a runtime binder
remove old $ only when it prefixes a fixed Relation//NAME model address

holds.reason: not proved HAV, HVC, cardinality, literal, or interval from the local CFEL/Subject expression; do not mutate mechanically

existing_helpers.use: fence-aware Claim partitioning; retains non-CFEL text and fails ambiguous structures
quote-aware CFEL and Subject handling pattern only; its unrelated old reference rewrites are out of scope

safe_phases: Freeze this carrier-pin and ledger hash; regenerate and require exact match before each batch.
Apply only deterministic narrowing and uniquely bound named-instance rows to Current/Draft source owners; preserve Summary, YAML literals and non-CFEL prose.
Apply legacy HAV -> := only to rows positively classified HAV; retain HVC :: and {::n}.
Route holds and any mixed carrier to its source owner; do not infer semantics from a glyph.
Run source validation and compare the regenerated ledger; actual Workbench/workflows remain external-owner scope.
non_claims: This preflight does not adopt Drafts, modify native/runtime/code/tests, or claim Actual Workbench/workflow migration.
